title: Core Paid Media Measurement Run
description: Run-level lineage, identity-match metrics, and additional dimension display names emitted by paid media measurement and attribution runs (e.g. Real-Time CDP Collaboration paid-media summary outputs). Carries per-run context and denormalized display values that do not fit the core identifier, metric, denormalized-name, or dimensional-breakdown fieldgroups.

xdm:measurementRun.title: Measurement Run
xdm:measurementRun.description: Fields stamped by a paid media measurement or attribution run onto each summary row.

xdm:moduleID.title: Module ID
xdm:moduleID.description: Identifier of the measurement module or report that emitted this row. Constant across every row produced by a single run and used to trace a row back to its originating pipeline execution.

xdm:matchRate.title: Identity Match Rate
xdm:matchRate.description: Fraction of source conversions that identity-joined at least one impression across the fixed match-key set, ignoring time windows. Typically populated only on the whole-input rollup grain and left null on lower-grain rows where a single ratio is not meaningful. Expressed as a fraction in [0, 1].

xdm:groupedConversions.title: Grouped Conversions
xdm:groupedConversions.description: Attributed conversions deduplicated by a resolved household or identity group. Complements xdm:paidMedia.metrics.conversions (per-conversion count) with a household or group-level count at the same rollup grain.

xdm:conversionEventType.title: Conversion Event Type
xdm:conversionEventType.description: Type of the source conversion event, carried through from the upstream conversion source (e.g. a dotted taxonomy like 'retail.purchase' or an ad-network event name). Customer-defined and unbounded: no fixed vocabulary is enforced. Populated on rows scoped to a single conversion event type and left null on impression-only breakdowns.

xdm:audienceName.title: Audience Name
xdm:audienceName.description: Display name of the audience segment for this row. Mirrors xdm:paidMedia.dimensionalBreakdowns.audienceSegment (the identifier) with a human-readable label; populated on audience breakdown rows.

xdm:placementName.title: Placement Name
xdm:placementName.description: Display name of the placement for this row. Mirrors xdm:paidMedia.dimensionalBreakdowns.placement (the identifier) with a human-readable label; populated on placement breakdown rows.

xdm:siteName.title: Site Name
xdm:siteName.description: Site or domain on which the impression was served. Populated on site breakdown rows.
